description: Baseline: tab bar with numbered tabs, file list on left, ASCII art preview on right. Clean split but monochrome list, no colour accents beyond theme selection.
Tab counts (38/36/46/48/32/3296), stripped .txt extensions from list, line count in preview header. Functional improvements but still monochrome.
Vertical divider, preview header bar with name+line count, status bar with position/count/navigation hints. Proper 3-pane structure. Jump from 6.6 to 7.4.
